title: Not all data is persisted for manual authentication method
body:
From OWASP ZAP User Group: https://groups.google.com/d/topic/zaproxy-users/3cJBTzer-HU/discussion

Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Start ZAP;
2. Create a context that uses manual authentication;
3. Persist the session;
4. Create a new session then load the persisted session. Check the log file or output, there should be some exceptions:
```
66807 [Thread-11] ERROR org.zaproxy.zap.users.User  - An error occured while decoding user from: 0;true;QQ==;0;U2Vzc2lvbiAw
java.lang.IllegalStateException: Manual Authentication Credentials cannot be decoded.
	at org.zaproxy.zap.authentication.ManualAuthenticationMethodType$ManualAuthenticationCredentials.decode(ManualAuthenticationMethodType.java:213)
	at org.zaproxy.zap.users.User.decode(User.java:331)
	at org.zaproxy.zap.users.User.decode(User.java:305)
	at org.zaproxy.zap.extension.users.ExtensionUserManagement.loadContextData(ExtensionUserManagement.java:255)
	at org.parosproxy.paros.model.Model.loadContext(Model.java:499)
	at org.parosproxy.paros.model.Session.addContext(Session.java:1253)
	at org.parosproxy.paros.model.Session.open(Session.java:408)
	at org.parosproxy.paros.model.Session$1.run(Session.java:249)
	at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:844)
166815 [Thread-11] ERROR org.zaproxy.zap.extension.forceduser.ExtensionForcedUser  - Unable to load forced user.
java.lang.NullPointerException
	at org.zaproxy.zap.extension.users.ContextUserAuthManager.getUserById(ContextUserAuthManager.java:110)
	at org.zaproxy.zap.extension.forceduser.ExtensionForcedUser.setForcedUser(ExtensionForcedUser.java:250)
	at org.zaproxy.zap.extension.forceduser.ExtensionForcedUser.loadContextData(ExtensionForcedUser.java:374)
	at org.parosproxy.paros.model.Model.loadContext(Model.java:499)
	at org.parosproxy.paros.model.Session.addContext(Session.java:1253)
	at org.parosproxy.paros.model.Session.open(Session.java:408)
	at org.parosproxy.paros.model.Session$1.run(Session.java:249)
	at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:844)
```

Remarks:
This is a known limitation of the authentication method:
https://github.com/zaproxy/zaproxy/blob/549d1eb9e185b1420654e6d3b2b844e2cb7469aa/src/org/zaproxy/zap/authentication/ManualAuthenticationMethodType.java#L211-L214

ZAP
Version 2.7.0 (and older).
